global_silver_linings.title: A Real Rockin’ Horse: Music Tames a Rescue Foal Who Learns to ‘Play’ Instruments for Album Debut
global_silver_linings.snippet: The video starts normal enough, but a surprise is waiting somewhere near the chorus. Mikayla Khramov is strumming guitar strings on Instagram and singing the lyrics to the famous Dolly Parton song 9-to-5. Then, a moment later, a horse jumps in, lightly chomping on the guitar strings to change the chords.
global_silver_linings.reason: A rescued foal finding comfort and curiosity through music is a beautiful reminder that animals, like us, respond to gentle care in the most unexpected ways. This little horse's journey from fear to playfulness shows what patient, creative rehabilitation can do.

news.title: ‘The bar here is low’: the best (and worst) supermarket brioche burger buns, tasted and rated
news.snippet: Brioche buns make an indulgent, rich home for a burger, but which have the perfect fluffy texture and which come with a chemical-like plastic aroma? • The best supermarket veggie burgers Brioche is a fabulously luxurious dough enriched with eggs and copious amounts of butter (often 25% or more of the total dough). Supermarket brioche buns, however, are a little different: the best products contain about 6-11% butter at most and some, surprisingly, contained none at all, using replacements such as palm fat and rapeseed oil instead.
news.blurb: The Guardian does the noble, slightly unglamorous work of sniffing every supermarket brioche bun so your next burger night doesn't end in disappointment.

fern_data.greeting: Late summer is doing that thing where the mornings feel borrowed — cool enough to fool you, bright enough to betray the heat coming.
